source_scope: All 100 original attachment samples; labels and human review are not inference or selection inputs.
proposal: Adjacent unique informative text-ASR anchors; 1 to 4 intervening reference words, ordered nonoverlapping ASR anchor times. No previous sample support gate or accepted output filter.
margin_interpretation: An engineering model-score ratio of 10, not calibrated correctness probability.
pronunciations: eSpeak-ng en-us isolated and contextual pronunciations. Whole-group context paths allow word fusion; original word indices retained at group level, without invented internal phone ownership. Equal prior over distinct complete phone sequences, maximum 64 per hypothesis.
competitors: Delete each word including both anchors; ASR alternative when phonemically distinct. Context pronunciations recomputed for every competitor.
acceptance: All word-deletion competitors (anchors included) lose by the fixed margin in both time contexts; phonemically distinct ASR alternative loses by same margin; unknown phone or equivalent deletion remains indeterminate. Distinct orthographic alternatives sharing a phonetic path remain indeterminate.
output_granularity: Research group-level candidates only; no invented internal word times.
controls: Different-video text/audio pairings through identical proposal and score pipeline; shifted audio windows with same text; existing zero signals. Controls are not natural error-rate estimates.
promotion: Require independent correctness evidence before replacing the stable delivery. Coverage and model agreement alone are insufficient.

pronunciation_ablation.contextual: Canonical and contextual pronunciations including fused words
pronunciation_ablation.lexicon: Contextual paths plus single interior-word replacements using up to 3 highest-prior exact-vocabulary pronunciations from fixed english_mfa dictionary; no phone alphabet substitution, same score thresholds.

development_record: v1 controls exposed a numeral G2P rendering defect and closed-set preference on unrelated audio. v2 corrects generic normalized numeral rendering and adds a transcript-free phone competitor. These controls are development evidence, not held-out validation. v2 whole-sequence plausibility rejected every proposal. v3 reports and gates excess negative log likelihood per target phone, rather than a cumulative sequence ratio; the shortest target pronunciation length is used as the denominator. This is a development change and requires separate validation.
normalization: Render the existing attachment tokenizer numerical parts before G2P; original word indices and text are preserved.
open_set: Require (target mixture log likelihood - unconstrained greedy collapsed-phone sequence log likelihood) / minimum target pronunciation phone count >= -ln(10), in both contexts. Fixed per-phone engineering tolerance; not a posterior probability or independent precision estimate.
additional_controls: After freezing v3, inject all available candidate windows into deterministic different-video audio windows, bypassing lexical proposal filtering to exercise the acoustic scorer directly. No thresholds will be fitted to these controls.
score_interpretation: CTC conditional phone-sequence scores P(phones | audio), averaged over distinct pronunciation variants with equal weights. They are not acoustic likelihoods P(audio | text), Bayes factors for lexical correctness, or calibrated probabilities of transcript correctness.
